svg.title: Slovenia study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Brda; 2: Vipava; 3: Kras near Sežana; 4: Slovenian Istria; 5: Podravje near Maribor; 6: Posavje near Novo Mesto; 7: Ljubljana

g.title: 6 · Posavje near Novo Mesto: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
